units.source_text: 名人幸运地出生于明治的勃兴时期。

en.t: The Master was fortunate to have been born during the rising age of Meiji.

units.source_text: 例如现在的吴清源就没有尝过秀哉名人修业时代那种人世间的辛酸，

en.t: For example, Go Seigen today has never tasted the worldly hardships that Master Shusai knew in his years of training,

units.source_text: 就算有人的围棋天分超过名人，也不可能成为历史人物吧。

en.t: and even if someone's natural gift for go surpassed the Master's, he probably could not become a figure of history.

units.source_text: 在明治、大正、昭和三个年代里，名人赫赫的战果，带来了今天围棋的繁荣。

en.t: Across the three eras of Meiji, Taisho, and Showa, the Master's brilliant record of victories brought about the prosperity of go today.

units.source_text: 显赫的功绩使他成为围棋的象征人物。

en.t: His distinguished achievements made him a symbolic figure of the game.

units.source_text: 这样一位名人要以这盘棋为告退增光生色，

en.t: If such a Master wished to lend splendor to his retirement with this game,

units.source_text: 人们理应成全他尽情下完一盘好棋，

en.t: people ought to have helped him play a fine game to his heart's content,

units.source_text: 这里包含晚辈的体贴、武道的修养、艺道的高尚精神。

en.t: for this contains the consideration of juniors, the discipline of the martial way, and the noble spirit of the way of art.

units.source_text: 然而，今天却不能把名人置于平等的规则之外。

en.t: Yet today the Master cannot be placed outside the rules of equality.
